# Warren CLI reference

This reference is generated from the Commander command tree so command names, arguments, options, and descriptions stay aligned with the executable CLI.

## warren

```text
Usage: warren [options] [command]

Control plane and UI for cloud-based custom agents

Options:
  -V, --version                    output the version number
  -h, --help                       display help for command

Commands:
  add-project [options] <git-url>  clone a GitHub repo into the projects root
                                   and persist it
  run [options] <agent> <project>  spawn a one-shot run, tail events as NDJSON,
                                   and exit
  init [options]                   scaffold a .warren/ directory (triggers.yaml
                                   + config.yaml) in a project repo
  config                           .warren/ admin tools
  doctor [options]                 check warren's environment: env vars, burrow
                                   socket
  db                               database admin tools
  plan                             dispatch and steer cloud plan-runs
  serve [options]                  start the HTTP server (default in docker
                                   entrypoint)
  help [command]                   display help for command
```

## warren add-project

```text
Usage: warren add-project [options] <git-url>

clone a GitHub repo into the projects root and persist it

Arguments:
  git-url                  GitHub URL (https or git@)

Options:
  --default-branch <name>  override the auto-detected default branch
  -h, --help               display help for command
```

## warren run

```text
Usage: warren run [options] <agent> <project>

spawn a one-shot run, tail events as NDJSON, and exit

Arguments:
  agent                registered agent name
  project              project id (prj_xxx)

Options:
  -p, --prompt <text>  prompt text the agent receives
  --trigger <label>    run trigger label (default: "cli")
  --provider <name>    per-run override of agent frontmatter.provider
  --model <name>       per-run override of agent frontmatter.model
  -h, --help           display help for command
```

## warren init

```text
Usage: warren init [options]

scaffold a .warren/ directory (triggers.yaml + config.yaml) in a project repo

Options:
  --project <id>         target a registered project by id (writes into its
                         warren clone)
  --cwd <path>           target a directory on disk (defaults to process.cwd())
  --default-role <name>  pin defaults.defaultRole to this registered agent
  -h, --help             display help for command
```

```text
Usage: warren config migrate [options]
```

## warren doctor

```text
Usage: warren doctor [options]

check warren's environment: env vars, burrow socket

Options:
  --no-auth   skip the WARREN_API_TOKEN check (loopback dev mode)
  --verbose   print raw probe/driver output (withheld from check messages) to
              stderr
  -h, --help  display help for command
```

```text
Usage: warren db migrate-to-postgres [options]

Options:
```

## warren plan

```text
Usage: warren plan [options] [command]

dispatch and steer cloud plan-runs

Options:
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  run [options] <plan-id>         dispatch a serial plan-run against a remote
                                  warren and tail events as NDJSON
  cancel [options] <plan-run-id>  cancel a remote plan-run and its in-flight
                                  child run
  status [options] <plan-run-id>  render a plan-run's child-state table with
                                  per-child cost + duration
  list [options]                  list plan-runs, optionally filtered by project
                                  / state
  help [command]                  display help for command
```

## warren plan run

```text
Usage: warren plan run [options] <plan-id>

dispatch a serial plan-run against a remote warren and tail events as NDJSON

Arguments:
  plan-id                   seeds plan id (pl_xxx)

Options:
  --project <id>            project id (prj_xxx)
  --agent <name>            registered agent name
  --prompt-template <text>  per-child prompt template override
  --ref <git-ref>           git ref to clone child workspaces from
  --provider <name>         per-run override of agent frontmatter.provider
  --model <name>            per-run override of agent frontmatter.model
  --no-follow               dispatch and exit without tailing events
  --output <mode>           output mode: ndjson (default) or pretty (default:
                            "ndjson")
  -h, --help                display help for command
```

## warren plan cancel

```text
Usage: warren plan cancel [options] <plan-run-id>

cancel a remote plan-run and its in-flight child run

Arguments:
  plan-run-id      plan-run id

Options:
  --output <mode>  output mode: ndjson (default) or pretty (default: "ndjson")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

```text
Usage: warren plan status [options] <plan-run-id>

  plan-run-id      plan-run id

Options:
  --output <mode>  output mode: ndjson (default) or pretty (default: "ndjson")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```

## warren plan list

```text
Usage: warren plan list [options]

list plan-runs, optionally filtered by project / state

Options:
  --project <id>   only plan-runs for this project (prj_xxx)
  --state <state>  only plan-runs in this state
                   (queued|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled)
  --output <mode>  output mode: ndjson (default) or pretty (default: "ndjson")
  -h, --help       display help for command
```
